newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli planes raid Hizbollah posts in s. Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli planes raid Hizbollah posts in s. Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes rocketed suspected Hizbollah guerrilla targets in south Lebanon on Sunday, witnesses said.

Two planes fired two rockets at the Iqlim al-Toufah mountain ridge which is controlled by pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) guerrillas and used for attacks on Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the raid.
A Hizbollah spokesman in Beirut said the group had no immediate details on the air strike.

Earlier in the day, an Israeli soldier and two Lebanese civilians were wounded when Israeli forces and Hizbollah guerrillas exchanged fire in south Lebanon, witnesses and pro-Israeli militia sources said.
Witnesses said two villagers were wounded when Israeli artillery pounded Iqlim al-Toufah.
The pro-Israeli militia sources said the soldier was wounded in the Sojoud area on the edge of the occupation zone.
